title: raydb_style regression root-cause and V4 device-output route repair

root_cause.finding: The measured V4 app-level row used the legacy paper_rt_optix_prepared_grouped_reduction backend, not the V4 device-output surface.
old_route_behavior: host_packed ray batch in the Goal4669 raw v4_current row
native grouped rows returned to host in the hot path
same prepared grouped-reduction primitive as the V2.14/V3 rows
root_cause.why_this_matters: The old row is a valid baseline measurement of the legacy route, but it is not a measurement of the V4 device-array/device-output frontdoor.

pod_rerun.interpretation: The repaired V4 route clears the V2.14 no-regression floor but does not beat V3.0.2; it is a route-binding repair, not a high-performance win.

next_required_action.description: Run the Goal4669 serious RayDB row after syncing the changed files, then update the 10-app matrix only if correctness and metadata prove the new V4 route executed.

goal_level_decision_audit.decision: repair the measured route instead of explaining away the 0.974x result
goal_level_decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No for this decision. It would have been foolish to keep treating the legacy-route 0.974x row as the final V4 device-output result.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: The earlier weak action was allowing the all-app driver to benchmark the old prepared grouped-reduction route while the V4 device-output surface existed separately.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: Only document that RayDB is parity/regression. That would preserve a false benchmark binding and fail the user's demand for app-level V4 evidence.
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: The app frontdoor and serious runner now bind V4 current to the generic device-output surface; the next truth test is a focused same-hardware POD rerun.
